w:r.w:t: Real Estate Developers & Property Marketing Companies
Expanded professional SRS with functional and non-functional requirements
This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) defines the functional, technical, and operational requirements for the

, a web-based platform that enables real estate developers to digitally showcase residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects through immersive 3D visualization, interactive maps, virtual tours, and comprehensive project management tools.

The portal will support multiple developers and multiple projects within a single platform while providing a seamless experience for local buyers, overseas investors, sales agents, and administrators.

The objective is to replace traditional brochures and static project websites with an interactive, data-driven property exploration platform capable of generating qualified leads, improving customer engagement, and increasing property sales.
The portal aims to achieve the following business goals:
Digitally showcase multiple real estate projects on a single platform.
Improve buyer engagement through immersive 3D experiences.
Enable overseas investors to evaluate projects remotely.
Reduce sales cycle through online virtual tours.
Provide centralized project and inventory management.
Support multilingual content and multiple currencies.
Integrate with CRM systems for automated lead management.
Reduce operational costs through self-hosted GIS and 3D technologies.

The platform will become a centralized digital marketplace where real estate developers can publish projects with interactive 3D visualization, allowing buyers to explore projects almost as if they were physically present.

Section 3 – Project, Building, Unit & Inventory Management

The Project Management Module enables authorized users to create, configure, publish, and maintain real estate projects. A project may represent a residential community, commercial development, mixed-use development, or villa community.
Each project acts as the parent entity for buildings, floors, units, amenities, facilities, media assets, pricing, payment plans, virtual tours, and 3D models.
Authorized users shall be able to create a new project.
The administrator shall be able to configure additional project categories.
Every project field intended for public display shall support multiple languages.
Future versions may support additional languages without database changes.
All transitions shall be recorded in the audit log.
A project may contain one or more buildings.
Each building shall contain one or more floors.
The Unit Management Module is the most important business module of the system.

Section 6 – Technical Architecture, Database, APIs, Security & Non-Functional Requirements
The application shall adopt a modular, service-oriented architecture to ensure scalability, maintainability, and future extensibility.
The solution shall consist of the following logical layers:
| Web Browser | Mobile Browser | Future Mobile Apps |
| UI | Authentication | Search | Booking | CMS | 3D View |
| User Service | Project Service | Lead Service |
| Booking Service | Media Service | Notification Service |
| PostgreSQL | Redis | File Storage | Audit Logs |
| CRM | Email | WhatsApp | Maps | Analytics | Exchange FX|
The architecture should support replacing individual components without requiring major changes to other modules.
These technologies are recommended based on current project goals. Vendors may propose equivalent technologies if they satisfy all functional and non-functional requirements.
